material.acceptance_criteria: ui_minimap.js calls setPointerCapture on pointerdown and releases it on pointerup, so a mouse press dragged past the canvas edge keeps moving the camera.
material.description: js/client/ui_minimap.js:186-193. pointerdown sets pressed and centres the camera; pointermove on the canvas centres only while pressed. The file never calls setPointerCapture (editor.js:289, play.js:1216 and replay.js:255 do). With a mouse, pointermove stops reaching the canvas once the pointer leaves it, so the camera freezes at the edge until the pointer re-enters. clamp01 at ui_minimap.js:180-181 handles out-of-box coordinates, which only arrive with capture. Touch is implicitly captured by the browser, so the defect is mouse-only. Witness: codesearch dispatches 1792858291900-4014-44d9352df8dea157 (capture sites) and 1792858346256-4193-eb35f0fc5aa17c85 (listener lines).

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:186-193. pointermove is a canvas listener that centres only while pressed (:192-193); the file has no setPointerCapture. Observable: a mouse drag that leaves the canvas stops moving the camera until the pointer re-enters; the camera freezes at the edge. Mouse only. Read: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433.

material.subject: Minimap drag stops following the mouse once the pointer leaves the canvas
material.witness: Live Chrome with real CDP mouse input, session verify-OWNERSHIP-trav-minimap-camera-1, sha 8d102946: press at the canvas (centre calls 1), drag to x=420 outside the canvas (centre calls 2, clamped to map x=100), release (no further calls). Control 43d4b5c4 (no capture) stayed at 1 after the same drag. CI: ci workflow success on 8d102946.
material.witness_plan: codesearch setPointerCapture on js/client/ui_minimap.js returns a hit, and a live drag past the canvas edge moves the camera target (witnessed by a dispatch id from a separate session).
